verdict.rationale: FireHydrant ships multiple AI-generated insight features inside the product: AI-generated incident summaries created automatically on declaration, AI-drafted retrospectives that produce timelines/impacts/lessons-learned, and a Copilot that proactively compares ongoing incidents to past ones and suggests actions in Command Center/Slack. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of output quality and no detail on the underlying model or accuracy benchmarks.
